meta.title: Deprecate BuildEventArgs.ThreadId and make it always return 0
meta.body_summary: Deprecate BuildEventArgs.ThreadId to return 0 instead of thread hash code, reducing performance overhead and memory usage, with obsolete warnings.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot deprecated ThreadId (set to 0) but missed multiple CS0618 usages; maintainer flagged repeated build failures, PR closed after several incomplete fixes.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 34 changed lines across 6 files, this is a tiny edit by absolute volume. Despite being a small performance PR, it was closed—not merged—because the change introduced build errors (CS0618) that could not be fully resolved within the PR timeline.

review_details.concern_detail: The maintainer repeatedly flagged that the deprecated ThreadId usage in the codebase caused CS0618 errors during build; Copilot's incremental fixes repeatedly missed occurrences in various test and production files.
review_details.performance_claim: Eliminates thread hash computation in BuildEventArgs constructor for improved performance and reduced memory usage.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer YuliiaKovalova repeatedly pointed out CS0618 build errors; Copilot attempted multiple fixes but failed to cover all locations; PR closed without merge, likely due to persisting build failures.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: A simple one-line deprecation change expanded into multiple build errors; the agent struggled to identify and update all internal and test usages of the deprecated property, showing difficulty in cross-cutting codebase awareness.

detection_detail.ci_auto: The build process (MSBuild with TreatWarningsAsErrors) generated CS0618 errors, which were relayed by the maintainer via PR comments.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance benchmark or measurement provided; only narrative claim of improved performance. Build failures prevented merge.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After multiple rounds of fixes, the PR was closed without merge, presumably because the build still failed or maintainers lost confidence.

core_change_summary.description: Marked BuildEventArgs.ThreadId as [Obsolete] and changed its constructor to set threadId=0 instead of Thread.CurrentThread.GetHashCode(). Additionally, replaced all internal usages of ThreadId with 0 to avoid CS0618 build errors, but multiple locations were missed initially.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Most files were modified only to replace ThreadId references with 0 to fix build warnings; the actual performance change is in BuildEventArgs.cs.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: Deprecated ThreadId and set to 0 in BuildEventArgs.cs.
First fix: Replaced 8 ThreadId usages in EventArgsFormatting.cs.
Second fix: Replaced ThreadId in BuildEventArgsWriter.cs.
Third fix: Removed ThreadId comparison from test extension.
Fourth fix: Removed ThreadId comparison from CustomEventArgSerialization_Tests.cs.
Fifth fix: Replaced ThreadId in BuildEventArgsSerialization_Tests.cs. Despite fixes, build errors persisted and PR was closed.

review_signals.summary: Noted the change touches *.swr files and suggested experimental VS insertion validation.
Reported that the build fails due to CS0618 after ThreadId deprecation; asked if Copilot would address it.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot committed a fix in EventArgsFormatting.cs (commit 3f7aac6).

review_signals.summary: Pointed out remaining CS0618 error in BuildEventArgsWriter.cs line 664 after first fix.
Reported CS0618 error in CustomEventArgSerialization_Tests.cs line 119.
Reported another CS0618 error in CustomEventArgSerialization_Tests.cs (different location) / BuildEventArgsSerialization_Tests.cs.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR to deprecate ThreadId and set it to 0.
YuliiaKovalova immediately flagged build failure due to CS0618.
Copilot responded with fix for EventArgsFormatting.cs, but errors persisted in other files.
Multiple rounds: maintainer reported remaining CS0618 errors one by one, Copilot committed incremental fixes.
Despite fifth fix, build errors continued and PR was closed ~6 hours after creation without merge.
